CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to an identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (C), organization (O) and status (D) are not all bound to the same referent/attribute/time with compatible evidence.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is related to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies represented content (tile coordinates) and labels an attribute (red).

D.rationale: Origin/record_status metadata is provided separately from the content coordinate lists, distinguishing identification from status/origin.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The text describes current/conditional candidate peaks and uses 'p0/current/...' naming to present how content is organized/accessed.
